caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular quilt design featuring green and red floral motifs. The primary elements are large, stylized green flowers, each with eight petals and a red circular center, placed near the center and edges of the composition. There are also red heart-shaped violet motifs, arranged in groups of four, forming circular or clover-like shapes positioned near the corners and between the green flowers. The background is white, with a textured pattern resembling a grid or net overlay. The quilt is bordered by two parallel green lines, creating a thick frame around the central pattern. The artist’s signature, "F. MARYNOW," appears in small letters in the lower right corner.
title: Hand Made Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
